_source: CLAUDE.md §50 UI / UX. The 4 core UI areas and the 22 fields below are §50's own lists, in §50's order and wording. scripts/tests/test_ui_contract.py parses them back out of CLAUDE.md, so a new bullet in §50 fails the build.
_reader: scripts/ui_contract.py is the ONE reader. Every field names a `marker` -- a `data-ui-field` attribute the page renders -- and the checker BUILDS the pages and looks for it. A field claimed here and not rendered fails, which is the difference between this registry and a design intention.
_why_this_exists: §50 is the only section whose compliance is invisible from the code: a field can be computed correctly, carried correctly, and never reach the screen. The previous audit was a 22-row hand check that found 6 fields missing; a hand check goes stale the first time a page is edited. Making the field list a registry with rendered markers turns 'does the UI expose this?' into a question the suite answers by building the page.
_absent_is_a_value: A field with `pages: []` is legal and must carry a `_why`. 'Not surfaced yet' and 'has no value to surface in this repository' are different facts. The checker refuses an unsurfaced field with no reason.
_no_hardcoding: Every field names the ONE reader that supplies its value. A literal typed into the page is the failure this column exists to prevent -- a page that says PERPETUAL because someone typed PERPETUAL is not exposing the market type, it is asserting it.

chart.what: The published chart artifact, one per style (scalping | day | swing, crypto and cfd). This is the page a human reads BEFORE a decision, so it carries the decision-surface fields.

panel.what: The method control panel -- the ACTIVE TRADING CONFIGURATION surface. §50's 'Trading Control Center must distinguish ACTIVE TRADING CONFIGURATION from AVAILABLE / RUNNING ANALYSIS' is this page's two-tier layout.

journal.what: Trade Journal & Performance. The only page where a trade has an ACTUAL path to compare against the expectation that was recorded before entry.

ranking.what: System Performance & Ranking. One table per §48 objective over every Trading System with a selected setup, plus the §48 exposure report. §48's markers (ranking-objective, ranking-sample-size, ranking-validation-state, ranking-test-period, ranking-assumptions, ranking-robustness) live outside the 22-field registry below -- this page's contract is scripts/ranking.py's own always_expose list, not a §50 field.

areas._why: The panel is the active configuration (what the pilot will trade); the chart page is the running analysis over it. §50 requires the two be distinguishable and they are two different pages, which is the strongest form of that distinction.
scripts/journal_render.py: pilot liveness, R curve, ledger, per-trade review.

No page. Candidate generation and experiments are markdown reports under docs/backtests/ plus the §42 record store under docs/experiments/, both read in a terminal. §41 blocks approval of any proposal today (no period in the repository can validate one, §44), so a System Lab page would be a UI over a workflow that cannot yet complete -- speculative under §57. Becomes applicable when research_ledger.periods() reports a validation-available period.

fields._note: Two values, not one, and the page must show both: the analysis data is SPOT while the pilot executes PERPETUAL (the §20.1 divergence on record). Collapsing them to one word would hide it.
CLAUDE.md §4: Data Source != Execution Venue. Printing them as one line, next to each other and separately labelled, is what makes the distinction visible rather than merely true.
§20's six states, computed over the candles the page is drawing -- not a green dot meaning 'a file was found'.

fields.source: the candle files' last bar time + the build timestamp
scripts/build-artifact.py src_notes (symbol · timeframe · provider · updated, per series)

fields._note: A published page is a snapshot, so the event-risk line carries its own as-of time and says so. An event-risk claim without an as-of is a claim about now made by a file written hours ago -- §20's 'never silently convert STALE to FRESH' applied to the screen.

fields.source: data/live/narrative per-method expected path (one per methodology, never merged)
the per-symbol synthesis row of the evidence matrix
scripts/build-artifact.py reason_text() over the lane reason keys

forbidden_words._why: §50: 'Use Confluence Score, not Confidence %. Avoid fake precision.' A percentage attached to a discretionary read is a probability claim the system cannot make.
